content.short: Popula is a NEAR infrastructure tool helping community developers build and monetize Web3 reputation via a community platform and Drips System.
content.description: Popula is a blockchain infrastructure tool that delivers three core services for community developers. First, the community platform helps creators amplify their work and foster social engagement. Second, Popula’s Drips System issues non-transferable tokens to record value-added behavior and signal member reputation, contribution, and commitment. Third, by leveraging the Drips System, the Community Economy Protocol Set aligns the community’s aims to bootstrap growth, monetize, and incentivize co-creation.
